items.title: Eat a Raw Fish
items.detail: Fast travel to Fisherman's Rest and eat each catch raw from your Pip-Boy

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is a good location

items.title: Complete a Daily Quest
items.detail: Open Pip-Boy Data tab and select a daily quest; Cop a Squatter is quick

items.title: Cook Grilled Fish
items.detail: Requires Grilled Fish recipe from Casting Off quest; cook at any Cooking Station

items.title: Kill a Human while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume item then kill cultists at Point Pleasant

items.title: Kill a Spooky Scorched
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport where Spooky Scorched spawn during event

items.title: Sell Grilled Fish to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell at any NPC vendor; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Find at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go or Grafton Steel

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops team and complete the operation; easier with a team

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build a Tinkerer's Bench in your C.A.M.P. or use the one at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Use V.A.T.S. to target the leg at Morgantown Airport where Spooky Scorched spawn

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense Feral Ghoul populations

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume then kill creatures; Poseidon Energy Plant has reliable spawns

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get from Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in a C.A.M.P.

events.name: Night at the Morgue
events.description: Mini season ticket event running during Spooky Scorched with weekly completion challenges for candy and Halloween-themed tasks.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal Halloween event featuring Spooky Scorched enemies wearing costumes and masks that drop special rewards and mystery candy.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Weekend event increasing the chance to catch seasonal fish with new recipes and challenges available.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Weekend event providing double SCORE rewards and increased caps drops from defeated enemies.
